title: fix: preserve upstream unsupported media status
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps upstream HTTP 415 responses as caller-facing 415 errors instead of remapping them to 502
- Adds the stable `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` error code and default message
- Covers the OpenRouter unsupported-image-URL response and shared status mapping

Fixes misleading model-health failures for invalid media URLs.

gist.headline: 415s keep their wings
gist.blurb: Invalid image URLs now get the honest little error they earned. The hive preserves upstream 415 responses instead of dressing them up as mysterious 502 model-health trouble.
gist.summary: Preserved upstream HTTP 415 responses as caller-facing 415 errors, added the stable UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE code and default message, and covered OpenRouter unsupported image URLs in shared status mapping.
gist.impact: Apps sending an unsupported or invalid image URL now receive a clear 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE response instead of a misleading 502 that suggests the model is unhealthy.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy API garden scene where Polli acts as a careful mail carrier, routing an image URL envelope to the correct clearly labeled 415 mailbox rather than the ominous-but-wrong 502 bin. A small CRT monitor robot can display a supported-image checkmark, with code-plants and flowers making the error-routing system feel orderly and friendly.
